goal: Decide locally whether the observed Customer, Vendor and Item/Service surfaces are sufficient to prepare a narrow write-gate, or whether template/foundation gaps must be handled first.
whyNow: MASTER-DATA-FIELD-MAP-READFIRST-VALIDATION proved the real Business Central surfaces read-first, but explicitly did not approve records, templates, setup or process work.
expectedOutput: A local decision result JSON that selects exactly one next case.
Classification of customer, vendor and item/service template or write-gate readiness.
Clear no-write boundary for any future template or record action.
stopConditions: Stop if the read-first evidence is missing or contradicts playthru / UNIVERSAARL-DE.
Stop if the decision would approve direct record writes without a separate Smart Decision.
Stop if template behavior is inferred without evidence.
Stop if Foundation gaps are treated as solved by visible fields alone.

nextCaseOptions.when: Use only if the local decision isolates descriptive customer fields and parks posting/VAT/payment/template dependencies.
Use if template dialogs or mandatory markers must be inspected before any write-gate.
Use if Foundation setup gaps still block even a narrow descriptive master-data write gate.
